subject: Post-call: Data handling confirmation and DPA next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alec Hughes <alec.hughes@dataopssolutions.com>
Cc: Security Team <secops@dataopssolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Data handling confirmation and DPA next steps

Hi Alec / SecOps team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the commercial paperwork moving: 

Summary from our call:
- DataOps will run a 3-month pilot (EU region) using Redwood Hosted endpoints.
- Customer asks: no training/model-improvement on any customer-provided inputs (including logs, prompts, or uploads).
- PII handling: DataOps will mark structured PII in records; Redwood to apply our redaction pipeline and not persist any raw PII beyond logging retention window.
- Logging & retention: you requested request/response logs only for troubleshooting and audits; suggested retention 90 days.
- Data residency: all customer content must remain in EU region (we discussed eu-west-1).

Action items I promised: 
1) Send a short confirmation email thread that explicitly states "no training or model improvement" on customer data (so your legal has written confirmation).
2) Attach our editable DPA draft (I have our standard template with a "no-training" clause placeholder).
3) Share the DocuSign link once we have signed confirmation from your side.

See attached: redwood-dpa-draft-20261210.pdf (editable) — will fill the no-training clause once we get your signed confirmation.

Could you reply to this thread with the confirmation language from your legal/security (one short paragraph is fine) and the preferred log-retention window (confirming 90 days would be great)? Once we have that, I’ll spin this to legal Ops and route the DPA via DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft-20261210.pdf (application/pdf, 278 KB)

From: Alec Hughes <alec.hughes@dataopssolutions.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Security Team <secops@dataopssolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Data handling confirmation and DPA next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Per our legal and security review, DataOps confirms the following and we are attaching a signed statement for your records: 

1) Training opt-out: DataOps will not permit Redwood to use any customer-provided inputs (including logs, prompts, file uploads, or derived artifacts) for model training, fine-tuning, or any model improvement activities. This includes any internal model evaluation processes that use raw customer content.

2) PII: Any data we send that contains PII must be handled by Redwood in accordance with the agreed redaction and minimization controls. If full redaction is not possible for troubleshooting, we require a documented justification and a time-limited exception.

3) Logging & retention: We agree to a 90-day retention window for request/response logs used for debugging and audit. Logs beyond 90 days must be purged unless we provide explicit written exception for a specific case.

4) Data residency: All customer content (transit and at-rest) must remain within the EU region; eu-west-1 was discussed as the primary hosting region.

Attached: dataops-training-optout-signed.pdf — this is our signed one-paragraph confirmation that the data may not be used for training or model improvement. Please incorporate this language into the DPA and route for signature.

Alec Hughes
Head of Platform Security, DataOps Solutions
alec.hughes@dataopssolutions.com

Attachment: dataops-training-optout-signed.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Data handling confirmation and DPA next steps

Laura / Rishi — forwarding Alec's signed confirmation (attached) that DataOps is opting out of training on customer data and requiring EU residency + 90-day logs.

Key asks for Legal/Ops: 
- Please add the signed paragraph into the DPA (see placeholder in attached redwood-dpa-draft-20261210.pdf).
- Add explicit clause: "Provider shall not use Customer Data for model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation that would change model parameters or be used to improve Provider models."
- Confirm whether 90-day logs retention is OK commercially or if we should propose 30/60 as fallback.
- Route DPA via DocuSign to Alec once updated. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/78941 (RDW-78941).

I am available to jump on a quick legal+security sync if helpful. If approved, I'll send DocuSign link and escalate to Sales Ops for final pricing adjustments for pilot.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: dataops-training-optout-signed.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)
Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft-20261210.pdf (application/pdf, 278 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Data handling confirmation and DPA next steps

Thanks for the forward, Marissa — clear. Legal is comfortable with standard language but we need to make the no-training clause explicit and non-ambiguous. Suggested insertion for the DPA: 

"No-Training; Model Improvement Prohibition: Provider shall not use, incorporate, or otherwise process Customer Data for the purpose of training, fine-tuning, benchmarking, or improving any machine learning model or services offered by Provider or its affiliates. Provider shall segregate Customer Data and ensure it is not included in any corpora or datasets used for model development.

Provider may retain de-identified telemetry for service reliability and system health, provided such telemetry cannot be reverse-engineered to reconstruct Customer Data; retention of telemetry shall be limited to 90 days unless Customer provides a written exception.
"

Action items from Legal: 
- We will update the DPA and include the signed customer statement as an exhibit.
- I will instruct Legal Ops to route the DPA via DocuSign to Alec. Expect a draft back to you within 24 hours.

Rishi: please note potential pricing delta for pilot with no-training restriction; Sales Ops should flag any impact on discounts or credits. Marissa — once DocuSign sent, advise so we can track signature.

Laura
VP, Legal & Compliance
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
